purpose: Bounded selected-workload admissions/compilation diagnostics for optional-feature baseline
limitations: Diagnostic PERF/compile/log output and possible concurrent compiler builds/tests exclude these scores/durations from acceptance.
Compile diagnostics are static-only and add no native runtime counter instructions.
Upstream timed workloads perform different work counts; this is not a normalized throughput comparison.
Optimizer compile seconds are a subset of enclosing JIT compile seconds, not additional exclusive time.
